items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1957-03-26
items.q: When he says that he's one of the many New Orleans boys who got their first break with you.

ctx.x: Oh, say there was a fleet of them. Yeah. There was a fleet of them. You know who this is, don't you?

Oh, yes, I know that one. Mm-hmm. That's a nice message that Gussie Mueller wrote you on. I'm copying it down because that's written proof, you know? Mm-hmm. When he says that he's one of the many New Orleans boys who got their first break with you. Yeah. It's a nice thing of him to say.
Yeah, that's when Georgia comes down here, you know?
